## Neurochrome Vault 1.2.4

- Vault dashboard now opens instantly, even right after launch or during maintenance.
- Rebuilding the deduplication index is dramatically faster on large vaults (minutes instead of hours).
- Fixed a case where importing the same pack twice could skip deduplication and waste disk space.
- Split RAR archives renamed by your browser (e.g. "pack (2).rar") now import correctly.
- The app responds immediately after launch — no more startup stalls.
- Long imports show live progress instead of appearing frozen, and finished imports show up right away.
- 3D previews for newly imported models are ready faster.
- Improved creator/title detection for more archive naming styles.
- Editor polish: faster save workflow, quick online search, clearer mesh-check status.
